name: STI-088GP-BT.doc
method: soffice→docx→python-docx(段落+表格+文本框+页眉页脚)
text:
Model	STI-088GP-BT
Product Name	8 port 10/100/1000Mbps Industrial PoE Switch
Fixed Port	8*10/100/1000M RJ45 PoE port
PoE Ports	1 port supports IEEE802.3af/at/poe++/bt, with a maximum power of 90W per port / 2-8 ports support IEEE802.3af/at, with a maximum single port power of 30W
PoE Dog	Support
PoE Pin	af/at: 12+ 36- / af/at/poe++/bt: 12+ 45+  36- 78-
Bandwidth	16Gbps
Packet Forwarding	11.9Mpps
MAC	2K
Buffer	2.5M
Transmission Distance	10BASE-T: Cat3,4,5 UTP(≤250 meter) / 100BASE-TX: Cat5 or later UTP(150 meter) / 1000BASE-TX: Cat6 or later UTP(150 meter)
LED Indicator	PWR: Power indicator (green) / Uplink port: green 100M+ orange 1000M / PoE port: orange PoE indicator, green grid connection indicator. / V1: Main power indicator (green) / V2: slave power indicator (green) / V3: DC power indicator (green) / VLAN: Port isolation indicator (green) / S: ultra-far mode on indicator (green)
Power	Three groups of independent power input / POE: DC 37-57V
Operating Temperature / Humidity	-40°C～+75°C / 10%～90% RH No condensation
Storage Temperature / Humidity	-40°C～+85°C / 5%～95% RH No condensation
Dimension / L*W*H	Device: 156mm*119mm*35mm / Packing Box: 235mm*165mm*78mm
N.W/G.W(Kg)	0.9Kg/1.1Kg
Lightning / Protection level	6KV 8/20us, 8KV ESD electrostatic protection / IP40
Installation	Desktop, Wall, Rack mountable(with mounting hangers)
Certificate	CE-EMC EN55032; CE-LVD EN62368 / FCC Part 15Class B; RoHS
Operating Temperature / Humidity	-40°C～+75°C / 10%～90% RH No condensation
